dimensions.assessment: Affects NASA administration officials and designated congressional committee members receiving reports and international agreements.
dimensions.evidence: Any report or notice final report or notification required by law that is provided to Congress by NASA shall be provided to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation of the Senate and the Committee on Science, Space, and Technology of the House

dimensions.assessment: Administrative adjustment of report delivery timelines and recipient committees.
dimensions.evidence: concurrently with not later than 10 days after its delivery to any other committee or office.

dimensions.assessment: No appropriations, spending authorizations, or economic impacts are mentioned in the source text.
Amends internal administrative document handling and reporting distribution rules for NASA.
dimensions.evidence: Nonpublic reports, including privileged reports, reprogramming requests, and spend plans... shall be treated as confidential committee documents

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory requirement governing future NASA reports and international agreements.

missing_information: Any potential administrative cost savings or burdens associated with changing report distribution deadlines.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill standardizes congressional reporting requirements and international agreement sharing specifically for NASA, altering administrative procedures between the agency and oversight committees.
